decisions.reason: Hook discovery and execution requires real directory contents and subprocess behavior; retain the complete multi-hook behavior.
The async-for token fix requires the original tokenizer state machine and token package; do not substitute invented token streams.
Cross-module hook exceptions, subprocess failure and project-directory cleanup must be exercised together.
Inspect complete disp_trim and display-width helpers. This covers only ANSI trimming, not the accompanying format_meter change; keep partial-fix scope explicit.
New prepare_input helper has no buggy counterpart; preserve file/stdin encoding and newline behavior instead of inventing a buggy helper.
Regex change acts inside actual CLI splitting and argument conversion. A naked regex task would omit its calling semantics.
Inspect full format_meter and actual helpers; preserve unspecified-total behavior and numeric unit scaling.
Tuple-unpacking and prefix preservation need original Node/Leaf and normalization machinery.
Large bundled tracer, encoding, disable and repr patch needs original runtime context; coverage tracing may interfere with the tracer.
Special type-comment handling affects real Line/Leaf splitting. The new helper alone has no original buggy implementation.
Must exercise actual Python2 grammar acceptance, not a fake list of grammar labels.
Multiple grammar parsing, error propagation and whitespace formatting require parser package and integration fixtures.
Tab prefix column fix requires real Driver, parser and tokenizer state.
Import trailing-comma placement must retain original Line/Leaf and comment semantics.
Stateful EmptyLineTracker depends on actual Line metadata; fabricated flags are not full formatter qualification.
Click config-path validation requires actual CLI and filesystem behavior.
Inspect complete decode_bytes on original bytes. Only the decode component is bounded here; lib2to3_parse empty-input change remains outside that component.
Outside-root symlink handling requires real directory topology and Report behavior.
Broad line/comment representation and splitting rewrite needs original parser, tracker and formatter integration.
Inspect full format_meter and helpers, including user-defined left/right bar formatting.
Python-version-dependent async keywords span grammar selection, Driver and tokenizer; retain real package semantics.
Diff path labels are produced by format_file_in_place; original I/O and formatter context are necessary.
Decorator/comment spacing requires actual Line state and EmptyLineTracker; group with black/4.
Truth-value bug depends on absent __bool__, existing __len__ and real iterable/total initialization. Do not invent a buggy replacement method.
Nested comprehension/lambda depths require original bracket and Leaf tracking.
Missing total attribute occurs in partially initialized/disabled object lifecycle; isolated fabricated objects can change the failure.
fmt:on nested-node traversal requires genuine parse tree, comments and source columns.
Locale-dependent dump encoding needs a controlled non-UTF8 file environment, not the current default UTF8 runtime.
Disabled progress initialization, inferred total and instance removal depend on real lifecycle; group with tqdm/3 and /6.
Broad fmt:on/off rewrite spans visitors, line generation, comments and parse-tree conversion.
Typed-argument commas and split lines require actual parser/formatter context; group with black/8.
Aliased __future__ imports require real parse-tree types, including Python2 grammar; no synthetic tree proxy.
Inspect complete format_sizeof with original rounding boundaries. Only SI formatting is covered; bundled __len__ change is outside that component.
Writer closure must open and append to a real path, retaining original pycompat/stream dispatch.

limits: Routes are technical scope assessments, not permanent exclusions from the scientific population.
Five bounded components are engineering qualification candidates, not five independent full upstream bugs or the final model cohort.
Family labels are provisional; shared project and functions must be audited against historical pools before inferential grouping.
Package/filesystem candidates require a wider environment; do not fabricate substitutes or silently discard them.
